record.body:
## Description

R29: `README.md` lists the four pytest commands under Testing. `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` point to that section.

The README rewrite in `retire-test-sh` broke two tests that pin README text. This task restores them.

## Approach

In the README Testing section, add one sentence that states the fallback: when the configured suite `command` is empty, the suite runs `uv run pytest tests -q -n 4 -m "not tmux"` then `uv run pytest tests -q -m tmux`. Keep the sentence true to `FAST_SUITE_CMD` and `TMUX_SUITE_CMD` in `orchestra/conductor/suite.py`. In `tests/test_verify_budget.py`, change the expected text from `mode=full` and `gate=required` to `mode=full` and `gate=advisory`, which matches `.canon/config.json` and the README. Run `tests/test_tiered_verification.py` and `tests/test_verify_budget.py`. Commit on the task branch.

payload.title: Restore README text that tests pin
